pack.description: Original Alliance and Horde commander voice study for short arena callouts. These voices are not intended to imitate any Warcraft character or performer.

speakers.description: Original female announcer archetype with a clear, polished midrange and quiet authority.
speakers.designInstruction: A clear adult female voice in a neutral studio recording. Plain, steady, and concise delivery with a polished midrange, even pace, precise consonants, and quiet authority. Minimal emotion and no dramatic emphasis, breathiness, theatrical flourishes, character acting, accent imitation, or resemblance to a known character or performer.
speakers.referenceText: Today we are checking a clear and steady voice. Each short phrase should begin promptly, remain even in tone, and end without extra sound.

speakers.description: Original male announcer archetype with a clear, warm baritone and quiet authority.
speakers.designInstruction: A clear adult male voice in a neutral studio recording. Plain, steady, and concise delivery with a warm baritone, even pace, firm consonants, and quiet authority. Minimal emotion and no dramatic emphasis, growling, gravel, vocalizations, character acting, accent imitation, or resemblance to a known character or performer.
speakers.referenceText: Today we are checking a clear and steady voice. Each short phrase should begin promptly, remain even in tone, and end without extra sound.
